rent.note: furnished 1BR in Miraflores ~S/ 3,000 + ~S/ 300 building maintenance = S/ 3,300 at 3.44 PEN/USD. Urbania furnished 1-bed listings S/ 2,070-4,670 (mostly 12-month leases); a modest premium assumed for 1-3 month terms

utilities.note: fibre internet S/ 99 (WIN 500 Mbps regular price) + ~S/ 160 electricity and gas; water often inside the maintenance fee; furnished lets frequently include Wi-Fi

groceries.note: home cooking from markets (Surquillo) and supermarkets (Wong, Plaza Vea); no primary basket figure verified

diningOut.note: mix of menú del día lunches (aggregator dinner $4) and Miraflores/Barranco restaurants and cafés

transit.note: mostly app taxis (Uber/Cabify/InDrive; aggregator ~$7 per 3 km trip) plus walking; Metro Line 1 S/ 1.50 and the Metropolitano BRT are cheap but little used from Miraflores

coworking.note: WeWork coworking membership from S/ 634/mo (promo; list S/ 745), incl. Jose Larco 1232 in Miraflores; local spaces are cheaper (aggregator median hot desk $145)

simData.note: prepaid Claro/Entel/Movistar/Bitel chip registered with a passport, ~S/ 30-40 per 30 days; operator price pages would not render a phone-plan price

misc.note: gym, toiletries, surf lessons/board rental, outings, buffer

accomSeasonality._doc: Editorial: short-let demand peaks in Lima's sunny summer (Dec-Mar, local holidays and beach season); grey May-June and September are the softest months.
